biography: Felipe Lemonias, a name now synonymous with aggressive overtakes and tire-smoking exits in the Opala Old Stock Race, hails from the sun-drenched coastal city of Santos, Brazil. His racing journey began not on a pristine track, but on the bustling streets, dodging stray dogs and weaving through traffic on his father's beat-up delivery bike. Those early experiences, he says, honed his reflexes and instilled a fearless approach to speed. His first taste of organized motorsport came at age 16, salvaging parts from his father's junkyard to build a makeshift kart. The raw talent was undeniable. After winning a local karting championship, he caught the eye of a retired Opala racer, who saw in Felipe the same fire that had fueled his own career. Now, at 29, Felipe is a force to be reckoned with, a crowd favorite known for his daring maneuvers and unwavering commitment to the checkered flag. He is currently fighting for the championship in the Opala Old Stock Race, demonstrating his peak form.
drivingStyle: Felipe's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos.' He's an aggressive late-braker, often throwing his Opala into corners with a confidence that borders on recklessness. While some criticize his approach as overly risky, his tire management is surprisingly good, allowing him to push hard throughout the race. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest. His natural talent and instinctive understanding of the car's limits allows him to extract maximum performance, often surprising even himself.

rivalries.name: Ricardo 'The Professor' Albuquerque
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry born from contrasting styles. Ricardo is known for his calculated and smooth driving, often clashing with Felipe's more aggressive approach.

rivalries.name: Isabela 'Storm' Torres
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle for position that escalated into a personal feud after a controversial collision forced Isabela out of a race.

rivalries.name: Joao 'The Wall' Costa
rivalries.reason: Joao is known for blocking and defending at all costs, often frustrating Felipe who is known for his overtakes.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother.
Listens to the same classic samba song before every race to calm his nerves.
Always adjusts his helmet strap three times before entering the car.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about finesse, it's about having the bigger set of *cojones* and knowing when to use them."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2022 Interlagos Opala Old Stock Race after starting from the back of the grid, overtaking 25 cars in a masterful display of skill and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the 2021 Curitiba race while leading, costing him valuable championship points and severely damaging his car.
